department: Biomedical Sciences Graduate Program (BIMS), School of Medicine

deadline.value: Fall 2027 applications close November 15, 2026 (11:59 pm Eastern); the portal opened September 1.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for Fall 2027 is November 15, 2026.

fee_waiver.value: BIMS says it is not offering application fee waivers to international applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: We are not currently offering fee waivers to International applicants fee waivers at this time.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not considered and not requested.
gre_general.quote: GREs are no longer considered for admission into our program and applicants will not be requested to submit scores on the application.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores of any kind are not considered.
gre_subject.quote: GREs are no longer considered for admission into our program and applicants will not be requested to submit scores on the application.

supervisor.value: Students do lab rotations in the first year and choose a thesis adviser and PhD degree program after winter break.
supervisor.quote: select a thesis adviser and a PhD degree program

funding.value: All students receive tuition, health/dental insurance and a stipend.
funding.quote: All students will receive tuition, health/dental insurance, and a competitive stipend.

entry_route.value: Applicants need an undergraduate degree (minimum GPA 3.0); a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: All applicants should have earned or should be in the process of earning an undergraduate degree at an accredited institution.

notes: BIMS is one umbrella admission to PhDs in Biochemistry & Molecular Genetics, Biophysics, Cell Biology, Computational Biology, Experimental Pathology, Microbiology, Neuroscience, Pharmacology and Physiology; students pick the PhD program after rotations. Biomedical Engineering is a BIMS-affiliated mentoring route.
